spaceworldmons.species.betakanto.desc: This Pokémon is rumored to have once resided within the Kanto region.
spaceworldmons.species.betakantojohto.de: This Pokémon is rumored to have once resided within the Kanto and Johto regions.
spaceworldmons.species.betakantojohtosin: This Pokémon is rumored to have once resided within the Kanto, Johto, and Sinnoh regions.
spaceworldmons.species.betajohto.desc: This Pokémon is rumored to have once resided within the Johto region.
spaceworldmons.species.betahoenn.desc: This Pokémon is rumored to have once resided within the Hoenn region.
spaceworldmons.species.betasinnoh.desc: This Pokémon is rumored to have once resided within the Sinnoh region.
spaceworldmons.species.betaunova.desc: This Pokémon is rumored to have once resided within the Unova region.
spaceworldmons.species.betakalos.desc: This Pokémon is rumored to have once resided within the Kalos region.
spaceworldmons.species.betaalola.desc: This Pokémon is rumored to have once resided within the Alola region.
spaceworldmons.species.betagalar.desc: This Pokémon is rumored to have once resided within the Galar region.
spaceworldmons.species.betapaldea.desc: This Pokémon is rumored to have once resided within the Paldea region.
cobblemon.species.godzillante.name: Godzillante
cobblemon.species.gorillaimo.name: Gorillaimo
cobblemon.species.quadragon.name: Quadragon
spaceworldmons.species.quadragon.desc: Amongst packs of Quadragon, the 4th strongest is always the most respected.
cobblemon.species.kabin.name: Kabin
cobblemon.species.buhi.name: Buhī
cobblemon.species.papyo.name: Papyō
cobblemon.species.omega.name: Omega
spaceworldmons.species.omega.desc: A powerful mechanical Pokémon developed by Silph Co. Its designs were specified by Team Rocket.
cobblemon.species.decilla.name: Decilla
cobblemon.species.gyaoon.name: Gyaoon
cobblemon.species.nidoreign.name: Nidoreign
cobblemon.species.barunda.name: Barunda
spaceworldmons.species.barunda.desc: This Pokémon has an organ that can convert oxygen into helium, which it stores within it’s body to float freely in the air. Researchers believe that Barunda's unique composition is what made it so elusive.
cobblemon.species.buu.name: Buu
cobblemon.species.deer.name: Deer
cobblemon.species.trampel.name: Trampel
cobblemon.species.crocky.name: Crocky
cobblemon.species.blottle.name: Blottle
spaceworldmons.species.blottle.desc: Blottle's suction cups produce a potentially dangerous hemotoxin. However, the dosage is too small to harm healthy adults.
cobblemon.species.pendraken.name: Pendraken
spaceworldmons.species.pendraken.desc: It's highly venomous tentacles can pierce the toughest scales. Known as the escape artist of the sea, Pendraken has even been known to break out of the Pokéballs of unprepared trainers.
cobblemon.species.cactus.name: Cactus
cobblemon.species.jagg.name: Jagg
cobblemon.species.kobat.name: Kobat
spaceworldmons.species.kobat.desc: When Kobat are first born, their wings are underdeveloped, which leave it unable to maintain consistant flight until evolving into Zubat. They can only drink a little blood at a time, leaving their prey only slightly anemic.
cobblemon.species.cheep.name: Cheep
cobblemon.species.jabetta.name: Jabetta
cobblemon.species.mikon.name: Mikon
spaceworldmons.species.mikon.desc: According to folklore, touching one of Mikon's tails brings one good fortune. Though there are rumors of sightings in several regions, this is unable to be confirmed.
cobblemon.species.ribbito.name: Ribbito
cobblemon.species.croakozuna.name: Croakozuna
cobblemon.species.skimper.name: Skimper
cobblemon.species.bawligua.name: Bawligua
cobblemon.species.cryithan.name: Cryithan
cobblemon.species.kokana.name: Kokana
spaceworldmons.species.kokana.desc: Though it looks like Weedle, Kokana is an entirely different species. Their diets consist mostly of leaves and berries, but they can eat through nuts and acorns by using their feet to crack their shells.
cobblemon.species.kasanagi.name: Kasanagi
spaceworldmons.species.kasanagi.desc: These sluggish Pokémon are known for their bell-like chirps, which they emit through their mustache-like antenna. During the summer, Kasanagi gather together and make music, snapping their fingers as they chirp in different pitches.
cobblemon.species.carapthor.name: Carapthor
spaceworldmons.species.carapthor.desc: Carapthor are notorious for their tempers. They walk the forests in groups, buzzing and snapping their fingers as they look for other Pokémon to fight. The speed of their punches can rival that of a Ledian.
cobblemon.species.weirduck.name: Weirduck
spaceworldmons.species.weirduck.desc: After evolution, Weirduck's headaches are only more severe. While this makes it nearly unable to focus, it's psychic powers have grown in turn.
cobblemon.species.konya.name: Konya
spaceworldmons.species.konya.desc: A life of wealth and prosperity is said to come to those who see Konya on its hindlegs, with one paw raised in the air. Scientists are baffled by the floating coins above Konya’s head.
cobblemon.species.missingno137.name: MissingNo 137
cobblemon.species.magnetite.name: Magnetite
spaceworldmons.species.magnetite.desc: Nobody understands where the spheres that make up its legs come from, which are quickly lost when evolving into Magneton. There exists debate over whether it is even a unique species of Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.guardia.name: Guardia
spaceworldmons.species.guardia.desc: They are rumored to take in orphaned Cubone into their pouches, fueled by paternal instincts and a desire for justice. They are thought to be related to Kangaskhan, though the connection has yet to be confirmed.
cobblemon.species.gyopin.name: Gyopin
spaceworldmons.species.gyopin.desc: Though most people think Gyopin are naturally tiny Pokémon, they can grow to large sizes if given enough space. It was once considered a popular pet, though it has since fallen out of fashion.
cobblemon.species.kotora.name: Kotora
spaceworldmons.species.kotora.desc: When charged up, its fur crackles like lightning. Its whiskers have been used to pass electricity into circuits to generate power in emergencies. If its tail is ever seen straight up like an antenna, its a sign that its about to strike.
cobblemon.species.raitora.name: Raitora
spaceworldmons.species.raitora.desc: In ancient times, Raitora were often a symbol of royalty and status. Its fur gives off a bright sheen even in the darkest environments.
cobblemon.species.gorotora.name: Gorotora
spaceworldmons.species.gorotora.desc: When the sound of lightning can be heard on sunny days, it’s likely Gorotora letting loose its mighty, ear-piercing roar. Kings in ancient times would seek out this Pokémon as a symbol of power.
cobblemon.species.puchikoon.name: Puchikoon
spaceworldmons.species.puchikoon.desc: It is big enough to be ridden on by small children. Puchikoon are often prefered to raise over its fully evolved counterparts, as its flames are immature and rarely cause damage to its trainer.
cobblemon.species.blastyke.name: Blastyke
cobblemon.species.kamex.name: Kamex
cobblemon.species.gorochu.name: Gorochu
spaceworldmons.species.gorochu.desc: This fierce and aggressive Pokémon is said to calm itself down by releasing lightning in a drum-like pattern, doing so atop high mountains.
cobblemon.species.index300.name: Korean Index 300
cobblemon.species.unadon.name: Unadon
spaceworldmons.species.unadon.desc: The body of Unadon is partially see-through, as it has yet to develop it's metalic scales. Large Pokémon will slurp down many at a time, leading to Unadon becoming endangered.
cobblemon.species.gurotesu.name: Gurotesu
spaceworldmons.species.gurotesu.desc: Gurotesu hunts using the weak lure on its head, swallowing it's prey whole. It lurks in the ocean, and the bottoms of deep lakes.
cobblemon.species.ikari.name: Ikari
spaceworldmons.species.ikari.desc: Not even the weight of Ikari's anchor can slow it down. It's chain of a tail is often used like a wrecking ball.
cobblemon.species.index304.name: Korean Index 304
cobblemon.species.index305.name: Korean Index 305
cobblemon.species.index306.name: Korean Index 306
cobblemon.species.index307.name: Korean Index 307
cobblemon.species.index308.name: Korean Index 308
cobblemon.species.index309.name: Korean Index 309
cobblemon.species.vatu.name: Vatu
spaceworldmons.species.vatu.desc: Having seen the future, Vatu is filled with the desire to make a difference. It travels far and wide, searching for ways to combat its visions.
cobblemon.species.index313.name: Korean Index 313
cobblemon.species.index314.name: Korean Index 314
cobblemon.species.index315.name: Korean Index 315
cobblemon.species.index316.name: Korean Index 316
cobblemon.species.shibirefugu.name: Shibirefugu
spaceworldmons.species.shibirefugu.desc: The spines on its body emit electric shocks that can be used to immobilize foes much larger than itself. These spines emit electric waves through the water, paralyzing nearby prey.
cobblemon.species.index319.name: Korean Index 319
cobblemon.species.norowara.name: Norowara
spaceworldmons.species.norowara.desc: It lives quietly in in abandoned, rarely-ventured locations. Rumor has it that calling out its name will curse you. Fortunate observers have noted a longing to break free within those beady eyes.
cobblemon.species.kyonpan.name: Kyonpan
spaceworldmons.species.kyonpan.desc: Ancient legends state this Pokémon was the creation of a wicked hermit. Due to its incredibly stiff body, it moves around by hopping. It is said to feast on the life force of its prey.
cobblemon.species.pudi.name: Pudi
spaceworldmons.species.pudi.desc: Pudi are known for being friendly and easy to raise. If you ignore it, it will bark incessantly until it gets affection.
cobblemon.species.hitokakushi.name: Hitokakushi
spaceworldmons.species.hitokakushi.desc: It guides restless spirits with great enthusiasm. Those who encounter this Pokémon report catching strange illnesses the following day.
cobblemon.species.hanamogura.name: Hanamogura
spaceworldmons.species.hanamogura.desc: When Chikorita sprouts it's flowers too early, it will turn into Hanamogura. Their lower bodies shrink into roots, as they need plenty of nutrients to grow into Meganium.
cobblemon.species.index343.name: Korean Index 343
cobblemon.species.komainu.name: Koma-Inu
spaceworldmons.species.komainu.desc: The former master of the Tin Tower. Once the Brass Tower burned down, Ho-oh and it waged a fierce battle. It hasn't been seen since. It is able to ward off evil spirits with its pure aura.
cobblemon.species.index350.name: Korean Index 350
cobblemon.species.index351.name: Korean Index 351
cobblemon.species.index352.name: Korean Index 352
cobblemon.species.index353.name: Korean Index 353
cobblemon.species.molambino.name: Molambino
spaceworldmons.species.molambino.desc: Molambino float around near the surface of oceans, breaching occassionally to show its scales sparkling in the sun. It was thought to have a connection to Gurotesu and Ikari, until one was observed evolving in captivity.
cobblemon.species.solamola.name: Solamola
spaceworldmons.species.solamola.desc: The horns on Solamola's head are made of the same material as human nails. Evolution causes it to grow rapidly, resulting in its scales breaking into distinct streaks.
cobblemon.species.manboking.name: Manboking
spaceworldmons.species.manboking.desc: The length of Manboking's horns cause lightning to be redirected. The energy gained from this causes Manboking to grow to unreal sizes.
cobblemon.species.honoguma.name: Honoguma
spaceworldmons.species.honoguma.desc: Though very cuddly as a Honoguma, it becomes much harder to handle as it grows up. As such, Fire-type Cyndaquil began to take it's place as a more popular first partner for trainers.
cobblemon.species.borubea.name: Borubea
spaceworldmons.species.borubea.desc: It's body is scorching hot to the touch. While Borubea is still quite friendly, it is not fully aware of it's own strength. As such, it often overwhelms inexperienced trainers.
cobblemon.species.dainabea.name: Dainabea
spaceworldmons.species.dainabea.desc: Dainabea barrels into it's foes with explosive force. It has a fiesty temperament, being willing to fight over the smallest things. Dainabea have been spotted burning down entire forests with flames sparked by it's mane.
cobblemon.species.index360.name: Korean Index 360
cobblemon.species.rinrin.name: Rinrin
spaceworldmons.species.rinrin.desc: The sound of Rinrin's bell chimes with a brass-like clarity. Though it prefers walking on two legs, Rinrin is as agile as other cats.
cobblemon.species.berurun.name: Berurun
spaceworldmons.species.berurun.desc: Valued for it's looks, Berurun is known to be a difficult Pokémon to raise. When irritated, it flicks it's tail creating an unbearably loud ringing noise.
cobblemon.species.kurusu.name: Kurusu
spaceworldmons.species.kurusu.desc: Kurusu was once considered as a first partner for Johto trainers. While Totodile has almost completely replaced it, the most dedicated of trainers will still seek it out.
cobblemon.species.akua.name: Akua
spaceworldmons.species.akua.desc: It glides across water as if there was little to no resistance. Some think that the teardrop-shaped orb on Akua's neck is the source of its power.
cobblemon.species.akueria.name: Akueria
spaceworldmons.species.akueria.desc: An incredibly resilient Pokémon, Akueria can safely deliver it's trainer through even the stormiest of waters. Sightings have been reported at the Lake of Rage, though Akueria does not seem to reside there.
cobblemon.species.index377.name: Korean Index 377
cobblemon.species.index378.name: Korean Index 378
cobblemon.species.index380.name: Korean Index 380
cobblemon.species.index382.name: Korean Index 382
cobblemon.species.index383.name: Korean Index 383
cobblemon.species.index386.name: Korean Index 386
cobblemon.species.kindachi.name: Kindachi
spaceworldmons.species.kindachi.desc: None who have witnessed it can explain why it’s constantly on fire, but some speculate it is punishment for their nasty pranks. They can take the form of others, but the smell of smoke gives them away.
cobblemon.species.wolfman.name: Wolfman
spaceworldmons.species.wolfman.desc: The pelt worn by Wolfman is thought to belong to an unidentified Pokémon. It playfully hops through the snow, keeping blissfully warm beneath the fur.
cobblemon.species.warwolf.name: Warwolf
spaceworldmons.species.warwolf.desc: It's sheer bulk and heavy coat let Warwolf march on through temperatures as low as -100°C. It's claws can slice through the hardest of ice.
cobblemon.species.bomushika.name: Bomushika
spaceworldmons.species.bomushika.desc: So long as it continues to bounce it's ball around, the coals will continue to burn. It enjoys performing risky tricks.
cobblemon.species.index392.name: Korean Index 392
cobblemon.species.index397.name: Korean Index 397
cobblemon.species.twinz.name: Twinz
spaceworldmons.species.twinz.desc: Both of Twinz's heads are constantly swirling around. For reasons still unknown, they are always moving clockwise.
cobblemon.species.index400.name: Korean Index 400
cobblemon.species.index401.name: Korean Index 401
cobblemon.species.index402.name: Korean Index 402
cobblemon.species.index403.name: Korean Index 403
cobblemon.species.index404.name: Korean Index 404
cobblemon.species.index405.name: Korean Index 405
cobblemon.species.index406.name: Korean Index 406
cobblemon.species.index407.name: Korean Index 407
cobblemon.species.betobebii.name: Betobebii
spaceworldmons.species.betobebii.desc: Betobebii are formed from excess grime that falls off of Grimer and Muk. Though it's stench isn't strong, finding a cluster of Betobebii forming is often a sign of more dangerous pollution nearby.
cobblemon.species.index412.name: Korean Index 412
cobblemon.species.hinaazu.name: Hinaazu
spaceworldmons.species.hinaazu.desc: The three heads of this Pokémon usually get along, the one in the back often gets the least care. Small twigs often get caught in its feathers, so it is prone to leaving messes in it's wake.
cobblemon.species.index415.name: Korean Index 415
cobblemon.species.sato.name: Sato
spaceworldmons.species.sato.desc: Sato has the ability to traverse land, air, and sea. This means that Pokémon everywhere have the chance to eat it. It's body is rich in protein.
cobblemon.species.turbann.name: Turbann
spaceworldmons.species.turbann.desc: Shellder take on many different forms depending on how they attach to Slowpoke. It is speculated that Turbann is the result of feeding Shellder severed Slowpoke tails, but few have the heart to test this.
cobblemon.species.madamuu.name: Madamuu
spaceworldmons.species.madamuu.desc: A rare species that is seldom seen. Recent studies have discovered that the object it holds is a spring onion flower. Those who claim to have seen it are captivated by its beautiful feathers.
cobblemon.species.monja.name: Monja
spaceworldmons.species.monja.desc: Monja's vines have yet to fully envelop it's body. While this gives it more mobility, it is very vulnerable in this stage.
cobblemon.species.jaranra.name: Jaranra
spaceworldmons.species.jaranra.desc: It lays perfectly still near bodies of water to catch unsuspecting prey, resembling a pile of seaweed. It can unhinge its jaw to devour prey much larger than it. It is not uncommon to see Jaranra in groups alongside Tangrowth.
cobblemon.species.plux.name: Plux
spaceworldmons.species.plux.desc: Taking advantage of its steel-like body, it lets itself take attacks, then pinches its opponent in its horns and flips them. Its elongated horns contain steel components.
cobblemon.species.animon.name: Animon
spaceworldmons.species.animon.desc: Its body is made of a dense liquid metal, which can mold and reshape itself into any form. It feasts on any metal it can get ahold of using its sharp fangs and magnetic pull.
cobblemon.species.tsubomitto.name: Tsubomitto
spaceworldmons.species.tsubomitto.desc: It lives by absorbing nutrients in the ground through its root-like feet. This affectionate Pokémon loves giving hugs and kisses with its venomous lips, making it hard to raise.
cobblemon.species.para.name: Para
spaceworldmons.species.para.desc: Para's favorite food is Big Mushrooms. It will dive headfirst into the cap, eating it's way back out. However, these mushrooms have a tendency to make Para sick.
cobblemon.species.baririina.name: Baririina
cobblemon.species.nameeru.name: Nameeru
spaceworldmons.species.nameeru.desc: In the east, traveling merchants keep Nameeru as security for would-be thieves. It can unfurl its tongue and ensnare a target in seconds, paralyzing them with its spit.
cobblemon.species.mitsuboshi.name: Mitsuboshi
spaceworldmons.species.mitsuboshi.desc: It is known as the Three Star Pokémon. The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.
cobblemon.species.piloswine3.name: Piloswine3
cobblemon.species.calfaraf.name: Calfaraf
spaceworldmons.species.calfaraf.desc: It chews on small herbs to improve it's psychic abilities. While Calfaraf's tail has yet to grow teeth, it's headbutts are still quite powerful.
cobblemon.species.kageboozu.name: Kageboozu
cobblemon.species.boyatto.name: Boyatto
spaceworldmons.species.boyatto.desc: It is unknown whether the mouth on Boyatto's foot is its true one. Photographers have been unable to capture it clearly thus far.
cobblemon.species.bi.name: Bī
cobblemon.species.totta.name: Tottā
spaceworldmons.species.totta.desc: Totta's expression never changes, making its thoughts unknown. Looking at it produces a calming effect. It polishes its body with a leaf after the rain until it is satisfied.
cobblemon.species.toroika.name: Toroīka
cobblemon.species.makki.name: Makkī
cobblemon.species.nobinyobi.name: Nobinyobi
cobblemon.species.gyarubi.name: Gyarubi
cobblemon.species.kanbok.name: Kanbok
spaceworldmons.species.kanbok.desc: Kanbok can store over 100 liters of water inside of it's body. On hot days, it will spray the water out like a shower while rotating. If Kanbok gets low on water, it's leaves begin to wither.
cobblemon.species.komari.name: Komari
spaceworldmons.species.komari.desc: Is known to guide those who are lost in deep forests with the sound of its horns. People who see it are believed to become happy. It shakes its head side to side, producing a clear, bell-like sound similar to a xylophone, in order to communicate with others.
cobblemon.species.monorabi.name: Monorabi
cobblemon.species.sutanbu.name: Sutanbu
spaceworldmons.species.sutanbu.desc: It stays perfectly still, mimicing a tree stump. At night, it roams around the forest, eating insects to sustain itself.
cobblemon.species.rikugin.name: Rikugin
cobblemon.species.arei.name: Ārei
cobblemon.species.keromero.name: Keromēro
cobblemon.species.mossmy.name: Mossmy
spaceworldmons.species.mossmy.desc: Commonly found in damp, shady places. It has moss growing on its body, which feels great to the touch. However, this moss absorbs energy, so it's advised not to touch it carelessly. It blooms beautiful, yet horrid smelling yellow flowers.
cobblemon.species.kodomin.name: Kodomin
spaceworldmons.species.kodomin.desc: It is capable of absorbing electricity through its horn. The horn on its head falls off once a year. Those with bigger horns gain respect from their friends.
cobblemon.species.puchi.name: Pūchi
cobblemon.species.kujatta.name: Kujatta
cobblemon.species.shakokaku.name: Shakokaku
cobblemon.species.elhawk.name: Elhawk
spaceworldmons.species.elhawk.desc: With its large wings, it can create wind as fast as 30 meters. A legend exists where it blew away the clouds and the sun shone down on the people.
cobblemon.species.penpin.name: Penpin
spaceworldmons.species.penpin.desc: In order to protect themselves using sheer numbers for strength, Penpin gather in groups of 10. These Pokémon are quite resilient, but are barely able to defend themselves. They have been hunted to near extinction by Spheal.
cobblemon.species.ribura.name: Rībura
cobblemon.species.furapoto.name: Furapōto
cobblemon.species.hakkeyo.name: Hakkeyō
spaceworldmons.species.hakkeyo.desc: Hakkeyō is remarkably quiet for a baby Pokémon. Instead, when Hakkeyō gets grumpy, it will begin to attack the nearest berry tree. When a snack falls out, it usually calms down.
cobblemon.species.otama.name: Otama
cobblemon.species.keromero.name: Keromēro
cobblemon.species.piyokko.name: Piyokko
cobblemon.species.ninfu.name: Ninfu
cobblemon.species.purun.name: Purūn
cobblemon.species.kajitto.name: Kajitto
cobblemon.species.raiou.name: Raiou
spaceworldmons.species.raiou.desc: Whichever in a group has the largest star-shaped mane is deemed the leader. Despite its size, its capable of reaching speeds that of a lightning bolt.
cobblemon.species.berumusu.name: Berumūsu
cobblemon.species.hipo.name: Hipo
cobblemon.species.chamin.name: Chāmin
cobblemon.species.evolotto.name: Evolotto
spaceworldmons.species.evolotto.desc: It is confirmed to change its shape at the time of evolution, but what causes it is unknown. It is a hot topic among Pokémon researchers. It has no visible mouth and ears, but it is only known to react to sound and light.
cobblemon.species.sunoun.name: Sunoun
spaceworldmons.species.sunoun.desc: Swarms of Snoun are often confused for snowstorms due to their snowflake-like wings. It primarily lives near mountaintops. The cooling cycle in its body uses ammonia as a refrigerant to chill the moisture from the air until it reaches a supercooled state.
cobblemon.species.bonbongo.name: Bonbongo
cobblemon.species.shiomagune.name: Shiomagune
spaceworldmons.species.shiomagune.desc: It drags its magnet-like pincers across the beach sand, which pull iron filings out from between the grains.
cobblemon.species.tochin.name: Tōchin
cobblemon.species.ponku.name: Ponku
spaceworldmons.species.ponku.desc: Ponku love to absorb water through their tails, which they then playfully spit out through their mouths. To them, its fun and games, but beware: the pressure with which they spit is strong enough to cut through metal.
cobblemon.species.tanpu.name: Tanpu
spaceworldmons.species.tanpu.desc: When Ponku attempt to absorb enough water, they begin to evolve into Tanpu in order to make space. These sluggish Pokémon gain the ability to control the temperature of the water they store, making them great for power washing jobs.
cobblemon.species.paotsu.name: Paōtsu
cobblemon.species.suiba.name: Suiba
cobblemon.species.uron.name: Ūron
cobblemon.species.shabo.name: Shabō
cobblemon.species.panpamu.name: Panpamu
cobblemon.species.hakogame.name: Hakogame
spaceworldmons.species.hakogame.desc: This Pokémon is said to appear near the beginning of winter, bearing gifts to people with good hearts which it stores in its shell. Sadly, this Pokémon has been hunted near to extinction for its gifts by those with impure hearts.
cobblemon.species.togepyon.name: Togepyon
cobblemon.species.zuruzu.name: Zurūzu
spaceworldmons.species.zuruzu.desc: It has a tendency to follow its parents off of cliffs, where it learns to use this loose skin as a parachute. This dependency on its skin for air travel is crucial for its evolution into Archaeon.
cobblemon.species.archaeon.name: Archaeon
spaceworldmons.species.archaeon.desc: The scales on its arms resemble wings, which it uses for gliding through the air. These very same scales are sharp to a razor's edge, and can be used for slicing. They tend to roam in packs of 10 individuals.
cobblemon.species.eidoggu.name: Eidoggu
cobblemon.species.uezari.name: Uezarī
cobblemon.species.tinki.name: Tinkī
cobblemon.species.sunorora.name: Sunōrora
spaceworldmons.species.sunorora.desc: Its body is dense with fur that keeps it warm in the oldest of regions. Some have spotted them gathering under northern lights, with their stripes shining underneath the glow.
cobblemon.species.yakkoko.name: Yakkoko
cobblemon.species.heppi.name: Heppī
cobblemon.species.supanku.name: Supanku
cobblemon.species.ryllidy.name: Ryllidy
cobblemon.species.kurumi.name: Kurumi
cobblemon.species.warabbit.name: Warabbit
spaceworldmons.species.warabbit.desc: Its relaxed nature and cute appearance make it highly desired among beginning trainers. However, its sheer rarity prevents most from ever seeing one. It floats on the water surface near beaches using its buoyant tail.
cobblemon.species.parasite.name: Parasite
cobblemon.species.badfish.name: Bad Fish
cobblemon.species.ascenshark.name: Ascenshark
spaceworldmons.species.ascenshark.desc: According to ancient folklore, this Pokémon saved a tribe of people from their dying, old world. The land it took the tribe to is said to have been the modern day Hoenn region. It is able to fly tirelessly using only its will.
cobblemon.species.psykou.name: Psykou
spaceworldmons.species.psykou.desc: Psykou are born from the emotions of people and Pokémon. Their adorable appearance and the glow of their life energy make them popular choices for pets, but their tendency to change moods depending on the aura they sense tends to leave them neglected by their owners.
cobblemon.species.psyking.name: Psyking
spaceworldmons.species.psyking.desc: Being comprised of mostly malicious aura, Psyking tend to be highly aggressive. They are attracted to negative energy, responding to it in kind by spreading its electrifying aura. It is surprisingly faithful to those who attempt to understand it.
cobblemon.species.bluedinosaur.name: Blue Dinosaur
cobblemon.species.stoneprimate.name: Stone Primate
cobblemon.species.demonclam.name: Demon Clam
cobblemon.species.pillarbeast.name: Pillar Beast
cobblemon.species.roccino.name: Roccino
spaceworldmons.species.roccino.desc: Roccino's sweat is incredibly high in salt content, which causes brittle stones to form on it's back. It travels in small packs, scavenging for food.
cobblemon.species.salegrosso.name: Salegrosso
spaceworldmons.species.salegrosso.desc: The salt from Salegrosso's back is used by gourmet chefs. While the flavor is divine, it is exceeding rare. Salegrosso makes up for it's poor eyesight with a powerful sense of hearing.
cobblemon.species.markedgolem.name: Marked Golem
cobblemon.species.rizagan.name: Rizagan
spaceworldmons.species.rizagan.desc: Its greed for gemstones completely vanished after coming into contact with a Dusk Stone. It's despised by other Sableye for this.
cobblemon.species.kimairan.name: Kimairan
cobblemon.species.dsilhou.name: Diamond Silhouette
cobblemon.species.psilhou.name: Pearl Silhouette
cobblemon.species.punky.name: Punky
spaceworldmons.species.punky.desc: Punky are still underdeveloped and need nurturing from their parent before being able to roam in the wild. It's unable to emit a constant toxic spray, instead only able to spit out small gas plumes.
cobblemon.species.jollibird.name: Jollibird
spaceworldmons.species.jollibird.desc: Jollibird command troops of Delibird to deliver berries to those who get lost in the mountains. Sightings of any are rare, as they typically remain in their dens, preparing for the next delivery.
cobblemon.species.gaillow.name: Gaillow
spaceworldmons.species.gaillow.desc: Its body has become more aerodynamic, allowing it to reach mach speeds. The crest on its head is well maintained as a symbol of power.
cobblemon.species.zeppblim.name: Zeppblim
spaceworldmons.species.zeppblim.desc: Its massive body is filled with a highly flammable gas, which allows it to propel itself across long distances. In ancient times, it is said that they would blot out the sky.
cobblemon.species.purretty.name: Purretty
spaceworldmons.species.purretty.desc: While this form is aesthetically ideal for those who raise Glameow, it is needlessly fussy and requires constant maintenance to keep its physique.
cobblemon.species.npartner.name: N's Partner
cobblemon.species.garock.name: Garock
cobblemon.species.awanezumi.name: Awanewumi
cobblemon.species.gurokken.name: Gurokken
cobblemon.species.tanisu.name: Tanisu
spaceworldmons.species.tanisu.desc: Tanisu's shell is rather strong, but a determined hunter can breach it's defenses. While it was once plentiful, Kaburion has hunted it to near extinction in the wild.
cobblemon.species.taniino.name: Taniino
spaceworldmons.species.taniino.desc: The red pigments in Taniino's horns are thought to be for intimidation. It stands tall and proud in the face of adversity, refusing to be hunted without a fight.
cobblemon.species.taniking.name: Taniking
spaceworldmons.species.taniking.desc: When a second piece of shell breaks off from Taniking's body, it will begin to wield it as a shield. Though it is more than capable of defending itself, most Tanisu don't make it this far.
cobblemon.species.kaburion.name: Kaburion
spaceworldmons.species.kaburion.desc: This cunning Pokémon lurks in the shadows. When unsuspecting prey walk by, Kaburion spit their acidic liquid with pinpoint precision. This liquid can melt through the hardest of shells, leaving an opening for it to drain the fluids of its prey.
cobblemon.species.nekkoyagi.name: Nekkoyagi
cobblemon.species.koala.name: Gen 5 Koala
cobblemon.species.ninjacat.name: Ninja Cat
cobblemon.species.chameleon1.name: Chameleon 1
cobblemon.species.chameleon2.name: Chameleon 2
cobblemon.species.flamingo.name: Flamingo
cobblemon.species.divingbeetle1.name: Diving Beetle 1
cobblemon.species.divingbeetle2.name: Diving Beetle 2
cobblemon.species.rudder.name: Rudder
cobblemon.species.cassowary1.name: Cassowary 1
cobblemon.species.cassowary2.name: Cassowary 2
cobblemon.species.chomame.name: Chomame
spaceworldmons.species.chomame.desc: Nobody knows what Chomame's body looks like beneath the shell. It is a favorite treat for many bird Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.mameja.name: Mameja
spaceworldmons.species.mameja.desc: Its massive yellow frills scare would-be predators away. The leaves along its back have a salty, nutty flavor.
cobblemon.species.raidon.name: Raidon
cobblemon.species.purplelurker.name: Purple Lurker
spaceworldmons.species.chikorita-beta.de: The leaf on this Chikorita's head has taken slight damage. While it is still perfectly healthy in most regards, it has difficulty getting the energy it needs to evolve.
spaceworldmons.species.meganium-beta.des: The flower around it's neck is different than that of most Meganium. It's scent is far more spicy, and the petals are much larger than usual.
spaceworldmons.species.marill-beta.desc: The soft pink color of this Marill contrasts the waters where they make their home. As such, Marill as a whole have shifted towards a blue color to blend in better.
spaceworldmons.species.azumarill-beta.de: It's body shape has not grown very much from Marill. However, it is no less powerful than other Azumarill.
spaceworldmons.species.murkrow-beta.desc: Unlike most of it's kind, these Murkrow prefer silver to gold. Their eyes are razer focused, allowing them to make out even the smallest of coins at a distance.
spaceworldmons.species.scizor-beta.desc: It raises its eyeball-patterned pincers over its head to intimidate its opponent, making it seem like it has three heads.
spaceworldmons.species.girafarig-beta.de: Active at night, these Girafarig have developed a taste for meat. The head on the back side is as intelligent as the one on the front, and somewhat more malicious.
spaceworldmons.species.hoppip-beta.desc: Its body is very light. When the wind blows, it's carried away to wherever the wind takes it.
spaceworldmons.species.skiploom-beta.des: When the wind blows it around, a seed-like substance is dispersed from the top of its head.
spaceworldmons.species.jumpluff-beta.des: Once it starts riding the wind, it can go so far as to circle the globe by moving its body dextrously enough.
spaceworldmons.species.tyrogue-beta.desc: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
spaceworldmons.species.hitmontop-beta.de: It has a special ability that prevents its eyes from rolling around when it's spinning at high speeds.
spaceworldmons.species.porygon2-beta.des: An early prototype of Porygon2. Its programming has advanced to the point where it can perform many simultaneous computations.
spaceworldmons.species.umbreon-beta.desc: When this Pokémon becomes angry, it can protect itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
spaceworldmons.species.claydol-beta.desc: This variety of Claydol may be older than its contemporaries. Its body is carved from stone rather than molded out of clay, which may have been the reason this style fell out of favor.
spaceworldmons.species.gible-beta.desc: This Gible prefers running to digging. It's body is more streamlined for movement above the ground, and it's bites have been likened to bullet wounds.
spaceworldmons.species.gabite-beta.desc: Its body is starkly different from a typical Gabite. It has a habit of gathering shiny objects and burying them deep in the desert sands.
spaceworldmons.species.garchomp-beta.des: It is unable to fly due to its smaller wingspan and stockier build. Despite this however, it can reach intense speeds when surfing through sand.
spaceworldmons.species.honchkrow-beta.de: This Honchcrow is somewhat more aerodynamic than most. The hairs on its beak are sensitive to changes in the wind.
spaceworldmons.species.basculin-beta.des: It is capable of leaping several meters above the water's surface. The sleek body of this Basculin makes it faster than most of it's kind.
spaceworldmons.species.escavalier-beta.d: A Shelmet that is allowed to grow into it's own armor becomes a special kind of Escavalier. As it's body is obscured, it is no longer at risk of ejection.
cobblemon.move.megaphone.desc: The user makes a loud noise, lowering the target's Special Attack stat.
cobblemon.move.crosscutter.desc: The target is attacked with large gnashing pincers. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.bellchime.desc: The user rings a bell to cure itself of poisoning, a burn, or paralysis.
cobblemon.move.uppercut.desc: The user attacks with a basic uppercut. It may cause flinching.
cobblemon.move.starfreeze.desc: The user launches an array of icy stars at the target. This move may cause paralysis.
cobblemon.move.inkspray.desc: The target is sprayed with a thick ink. This move may lower the target's accuracy.
cobblemon.move.baibaipunch.desc: The user assaults the target with a devestating punch. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
cobblemon.move.numbpincer.desc: The user crushes the target with pincers that leave them numb. This may also paralyze the target.
cobblemon.move.synchronize.desc: The user synchronizes types with the target, making it the same type as the target.
cobblemon.move.rockhead.desc: The enemy is hit with the user's rock-hard head. It may cause flinching.
cobblemon.move.windride.desc: The user rides the wind and rams into the enemy. This move has a high critical-hit ratio.
cobblemon.move.strongarm.desc: The user attacks by swinging its burly arms. This move may raise the user's attack.
cobblemon.move.brightmoss.desc: The user expells glowing moss from its body to attack the target. This move always lowers the target's accuracy.
cobblemon.move.uproot.desc: The user flings the enemy with intense strength. If the target is under the effects of Ingrain, this move deals double damage and removes the Ingrain effect.
cobblemon.move.rockslash.desc: The user cleaves the target with a jagged edge.
cobblemon.move.volcaniccannon.desc: Has a 100% chance to burn the target.
cobblemon.move.lurk.desc: Lowers the target's accuracy by 2 stages.
cobblemon.move.milktime.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, then is replaced with another Pokémon in its party.
cobblemon.move.scatterspores.desc: Causes the target to either fall asleep, become poisoned, or become paralyzed.
cobblemon.move.sprinkler.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field.
cobblemon.move.exitpath.desc: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
cobblemon.move.echo.desc: The user uses the last move used by the target. The copied move is used against that target, if possible. Fails if the target has not made a move, or if the last move used cannot be copied by this move.
cobblemon.move.passage.desc: The user is replaced with another Pokémon in its party.
cobblemon.move.lightningstrike.desc: Power doubles if rain is active.
cobblemon.move.pushout.desc: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
cobblemon.move.rapiddescent.desc: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
cobblemon.move.shuriken.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.
cobblemon.move.shadowcloak.desc: Raises the user's evasiveness by 2 stages.
cobblemon.move.joyfulrhythm.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
cobblemon.move.miragefeather.desc: Raises the user's evasiveness by 2 stages.
cobblemon.move.beakshield.desc: The user and its party members are protected from physical attacks made by other Pokémon, including allies, during this turn. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
cobblemon.move.melt.desc: Causes the target to become a Water type if they are an Ice type, or a Normal type if they are a Steel type. Fails if the target has already changed types.
cobblemon.ability.cacophony.desc: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have a 30% chance to cause confusion.
